mostWorthwhile.text: Comparing the old temperature and door logs, then checking the repaired cabinet independently, made the distinction between an explanation and verification concrete.

leastWorthwhile.text: The successive filter, fan, cabinet and power combinations were straightforward but became repetitive, especially with only one offered action at each point.

surprise.text: Most spikes coincided with door openings, but that did not establish what every stored object experienced. The renewal warning also introduced a new concern after the successful check.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though the linear repair sequence offered little meaningful choice in fast mode.

continue.text: Yes. I would like to see how the neighbors provide a fallback for the supply controller; the combination of practical repair and cautious interpretation held my interest.
